representation: A five-element array drawn as labeled vertical bars, with a pivot arrow and discrete partition states that reorder the bars and reveal the left and right recursive parts.
motion: state timeline selects pivot, scan, partition and recurse steps
bars move to new index positions between states
pivot arrow follows the pivot bar
checkpoints: partition is not a full sort
misconceptionTest: The final left part has three elements and the right part has one, so the split is not half; the array [3,1,2,5,8] is still not sorted, so partitioning did not sort everything.
accessibility: Array values are text labels, the pivot is marked by an arrow and instruction text, parts are named in text, state changes are also described in checkpoints, and no color-only cue is required.
